11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed: Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL-based depth shading (l=45/60/72) is genuinely sophisticated, typographic hierarchy is clear, and breadcrumb/legend chrome is clean — held back from 8 by the cramped 2px edge margins and label density at the overview zoom level that leaves many leaf cells too small to read.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Treemap area encoding is honest — d3.treemap() maps .sum() values to proportional rectangular area with data-driven domain; categorical color is correctly ordinal; no baseline, radius-scaling, or dual-axis violations apply; minor fragility in the string-concatenation key function (collision risk with duplicate sibling names) and rng() side-effects in cellFill prevent a higher score.
11-zoomable-treemap.stress_test_note: Interaction is click-based so no Update Storm or Infinite Loop risk; interrupt() is properly called before new transitions; pointer events unify mouse/touch; minor stale closure in t.on('end') captures mutable currentFocus by reference rather than snapshotting the value at call time.
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8 well-separated Tol colors and adaptive label suppression keeps the dense root overview legible, while click-to-zoom interaction offloads detail to on-demand drill-down rather than displaying it all at once; animation quality (object constancy during 750ms zoom) cannot be fully assessed from a static screenshot.
